name: pvlib python
description: BSD-licensed Python library for simulating photovoltaic system performance, from solar position and irradiance to module and inverter output.

name: NREL System Advisor Model (SAM)
description: NREL's open-source (BSD-3) desktop tool for techno-economic modelling of PV, battery storage, wind and other renewable projects.

name: PVEducation
description: Free interactive online textbook covering solar-cell physics, PV module characteristics and system design with live calculators.

name: Global Solar Atlas
description: World Bank/ESMAP web map giving free solar irradiation and PV yield estimates for any location, useful for sizing PV in India and elsewhere.

name: OpenEMS
description: Open-source modular energy management system for monitoring and controlling PV, home batteries, heat pumps and EV chargers.

name: Libre Solar
description: Open-hardware project publishing MPPT solar charge controllers, BMS boards and firmware under open licences for off-grid and DC systems.

name: Libre Solar Charge Controller Firmware
description: Zephyr-based open-source firmware for Libre Solar MPPT and PWM solar charge controllers - a solid PBL reference for open solar chargers.

name: OpenDTU
description: ESP32 firmware that replaces the vendor DTU to read and limit Hoymiles/TSUN micro-inverters locally without the cloud.

name: OpenEnergyMonitor
description: Open-source energy monitors (emonPi/emonTx) and software for measuring home electricity, solar generation and heat-pump performance.

name: evcc
description: Open-source EV charging controller that charges your car from surplus solar power and works with many wallboxes, inverters and vehicles.

name: PyPSA
description: Python for Power System Analysis - an open toolbox for simulating and optimising power grids with high shares of renewables and storage.

name: NPTEL - Design of Photovoltaic Systems (IISc)
description: Free NPTEL video course on PV cell characteristics, PV sizing, MPPT, DC-DC converter interfaces and battery charge controllers with Octave tools.

name: NPTEL - Electric Vehicles and Renewable Energy (IIT Madras)
description: Free 12-week NPTEL course on EV powertrains, battery storage and renewable energy in the Indian context (optional paid exam for certificate).

name: foxBMS
description: Fraunhofer IISB's free and open BMS development platform with hardware designs, firmware and documentation for large Li-ion packs.

name: diyBMS v4 (ESP32)
description: Open-source modular DIY battery management system for LiFePO4/Li-ion banks with per-cell modules and an ESP32 controller.

name: SimpBMS
description: Documentation and code for SimpBMS, an open BMS that reuses OEM EV battery modules (Tesla, Outlander, etc.) for conversions and storage.

name: Battery-Emulator
description: Open-source ESP32 firmware that lets second-life EV battery packs talk to home solar/battery inverters.

name: PyBaMM
description: Python Battery Mathematical Modelling - an open-source library for physics-based (DFN, SPM) battery simulations.

name: Battery University
description: Free educational site by Cadex explaining battery chemistries, charging, ageing and safety in plain language.

name: Battery Design (batterydesign.net)
description: Free reference site on battery cell, module and pack design for EVs and storage, covering BMS, thermal management and cell data.

name: OpenInverter
description: Community and wiki for open-source EV motor inverter firmware and hardware, used to drive reclaimed Tesla, Nissan Leaf and other motors.

name: stm32-sine (OpenInverter firmware)
description: Open-source STM32 firmware for induction and synchronous motor inverters that powers the OpenInverter EV conversion ecosystem.

name: OpenEVSE
description: Open-source hardware and firmware for Level 1/2 EV charging stations, with WiFi and solar-divert support.

name: SmartEVSE v3
description: Open-source smart EV charging controller firmware with load balancing and solar-surplus charging modes.

name: SavvyCAN
description: Open-source cross-platform CAN bus capture, reverse-engineering and analysis tool widely used for EV hacking.

name: NPTEL - EV: Vehicle Dynamics and Electric Motor Drives (IIT Delhi)
description: Free NPTEL course by Prof. Amit Jain on EV vehicle dynamics, motors, PWM, power electronics and drive control.

name: TI Power Stage Designer
description: Free Java tool from TI that computes voltages and currents for 21 SMPS topologies, plus loop, snubber, FET-loss and filter calculators (download needs a free myTI export approval).

name: TI WEBENCH Circuit Designer
description: Free web tool from TI that generates and simulates complete power-supply and filter designs from your specs; saving/exporting designs needs a free myTI account.

name: MIT OCW 6.334 Power Electronics
description: Free MIT OpenCourseWare graduate course on converter topologies, magnetics, control and design with lecture notes and problem sets.

name: Sam Ben-Yaakov (YouTube)
description: Prof. Sam Ben-Yaakov's widely recommended channel of clear, intuitive lectures on converters, magnetics, control and simulation.

name: CUSP - Consortium of Universities for Sustainable Power (UMN)
description: University of Minnesota's free curriculum with video lectures, slides and problems on power electronics, drives and power systems.

name: NPTEL - Power Electronics (IIT Delhi)
description: Free NPTEL course by Prof. G. Bhuvaneshwari covering power devices, rectifiers, DC-DC converters, inverters and applications like chargers.

name: NPTEL - Fundamental of Power Electronics (IISc)
description: Free NPTEL course by Prof. L. Umanand on power devices, AC-DC and DC-DC converter analysis and converter control.

name: NPTEL - Design of Power Electronic Converters (IIT Guwahati)
description: Free NPTEL course on practical converter hardware design - magnetics, gate drives, sensing, thermal and layout beyond textbook theory.

name: NPTEL - Advance Power Electronics and Control (IIT Roorkee)
description: Free NPTEL course by Prof. Avik Bhattacharya on advanced converter topologies, modulation and closed-loop control.

name: OwnTech
description: Open-source power electronics foundation offering the SPIN controller and TWIST converter boards with Zephyr-based software for learning and research.

name: OpenDPS
description: Open-source replacement firmware for DPS5005-series programmable power supply modules, adding remote control and new features.

name: EEZ Bench Box 3 (BB3)
description: Fully open-source modular lab chassis with programmable power-supply, DMM and I/O modules - a reference open lab power supply design.

name: python-control
description: Python Control Systems Library for transfer functions, state-space, Bode/root-locus analysis and controller design.

name: Control Tutorials for MATLAB & Simulink (CTMS)
description: University of Michigan's free CC BY-SA tutorials on modelling, PID, root locus, frequency, state-space and digital control with worked examples.

name: Feedback Systems (Astrom & Murray) wiki
description: Companion site for Astrom and Murray's 'Feedback Systems', with free PDF editions, exercises and python-control examples.

name: Scilab
description: Free, open-source numerical computing environment (MATLAB alternative) with control toolboxes and the Xcos block-diagram simulator.

name: do-mpc
description: Open-source Python toolbox for model predictive control and moving horizon estimation of nonlinear systems.

name: ngscopeclient (ScopeHAL)
description: Open-source GPU-accelerated oscilloscope and test-instrument client built on libscopehal, supporting many scopes, protocol decodes and analysis.

name: ThunderScope
description: Open-source 4-channel 1 GS/s PCIe/Thunderbolt oscilloscope with hardware, FPGA gateware and software released openly.

name: PyVISA
description: Python package to control GPIB, USB, Ethernet and serial lab instruments via VISA/SCPI for bench automation.

name: PyMeasure
description: Open-source Python package with ready-made instrument drivers and a GUI framework for running measurement experiments.

name: OpenHantek6022
description: Free open-source software for Hantek 6022 and compatible low-cost USB oscilloscopes, with FFT, math channels and XY mode.

name: Red Pitaya documentation
description: Open documentation for the Red Pitaya FPGA board that works as oscilloscope, signal generator and spectrum analyzer, with SCPI and examples.

name: ScopeFun
description: Open-source FPGA-based oscilloscope, arbitrary waveform generator and logic analyzer with open hardware and software.

name: Scopy (Analog Devices)
description: ADI's open-source multifunction instrument app (scope, signal generator, logic analyzer, network analyzer) for ADALM2000 and other boards.

name: PSLab (Pocket Science Lab)
description: FOSSASIA's open-hardware pocket lab with oscilloscope, waveform generator, logic analyzer and power supply, plus desktop and Android apps.

name: Learn Electronics Repair (YouTube)
description: Free channel on fault-finding and repairing electronics, including switch-mode power supplies, chargers and lab gear.

name: Julian Ilett (YouTube)
description: Free hands-on videos testing DC-DC converters, solar chargers, batteries and power modules on the bench.

name: DIY Solar Power with Will Prowse (YouTube)
description: Free videos testing and explaining solar panels, inverters, charge controllers and LiFePO4 batteries for DIY off-grid systems.
